name: hud_ui_fill_bitmap_draw
description: HudUiFillBitmap::Draw skips missing images, delegates the base widget draw, and blits non-empty fill and preview rectangles at base-position plus overlay offsets.
known_limits: tier S verification remains deferred to the HUD fill-bitmap/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4b8520 validates the preview/fill null-image early return, base Draw vtable dispatch, fillRect left/right non-empty guard, fill image blit at base x/y plus fill offsets, previewRect left/right non-empty guard, and preview image blit at base x/y plus preview offsets.

Native smoke zhud_fill_bitmap_core_smoke verifies the full base/fill/preview draw sequence and blit coordinates/rects, verifies null preview image skips all drawing, and verifies empty fill/preview rects skip overlay blits while preserving the base draw.
